LakeSnes SNES emulator core, vendored unmodified from
https://github.com/angelo-wf/LakeSnes at commit 9db90b86e46a377609305e298dd92d71cd1d4c8a.
MIT licensed; see LICENSE.txt.

Local changes (marked "topgear-pc" in the source):
- cpu.h/cpu.c: optional traceHook called before each opcode fetch; optional callHook
  there that can run a translated routine in place of the code at PC; a count of
  interrupts taken and of handlers still running (intDepth, lowered by RTI); a flag that
  holds interrupts off (blockInterrupts).
- snes.h/snes.c: optional readHook and writeHook called for every A-bus read and write;
  optional hdmaWriteHook called for every B-bus write made by HDMA (dma.c sets inHdma).
- statehandler.c: byte and word arrays saved and loaded in one pass instead of per byte.
- dma.c/dma.h: dma_runPending, to run a started DMA at once.
